cibil.title: Understand Your CIBIL Score
cibil.subtitle: Learn what your CIBIL score means, what affects it, and how you can build and maintain healthy credit.
cibil.understandDescription: Your CIBIL score is a three-digit number that represents your creditworthiness based on your credit history and financial behaviour.
cibil.checkDescription: Enter your CIBIL score to understand its category and get general guidance.
cibil.invalidScore: Please enter a valid CIBIL score between 300 and 900.
cibil.excellentMessage: Excellent! Your credit profile appears to be strong.
cibil.goodMessage: Good! Maintaining healthy financial habits can help improve your score further.
cibil.improvementMessage: Your score may need improvement. Focus on timely payments and responsible credit usage.
cibil.improveTitle: Ways to Improve Your CIBIL Score
cibil.payEmiDescription: Try to make all loan EMIs and credit card payments before their due dates.
cibil.creditUsageDescription: Avoid using too much of your available credit limit whenever possible.
cibil.trackBillsDescription: Monitor recurring bills and repayments so you do not miss due dates or build avoidable debt.
cibil.applicationsDescription: Apply for credit only when necessary instead of submitting multiple applications at once.
cibil.reviewDescription: Regularly reviewing your credit information can help you identify errors or unusual activity.
